name: smwmusic-rudra-no-hihou-light-under-the-sea-underwater-city-remix
title: Rudra no Hihou - Light Under The Sea ~ Underwater City (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Underwater City from Rudra no Hihou (Treasure of the Rudras in English). Thought it'd be fun to do my own take on another Squ'enix theme, though I have not gotten the chance to play this game yet. Mostly heard this OST from other hacks and from listening to the soundtrack on my own time in the past.

Regardless, absolutely amazing theme!! Has a very ancient yet magical vibe that Square was definitely known for doing with a lot of their traditional RPG OSTs at the time.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. B Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch - Listening-Only)
2. B Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
3. A Minor (Original Pitch)
4. C Minor (Custom Pitch)
